dedupe_keys.name: worldwide catalogue of spatio climatic devices public spaces with urban cooling techniques coolscapes

description: This catalogue lists built public spaces worldwide that integrate urban cooling techniques, termed spatio-climatic devices, with descriptive and qualitative data for each. It was published on Zenodo on 30 March 2021 by Ignacio Requena-Ruiz within the COOLSCAPES project, supported by the French Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR-18-CE22-0003). Descriptive columns give location, actors involved, technical means and information sources; qualitative columns summarise a coding of each device's spatial layout, climatic effect and urban experience by two researchers. Coverage: public spaces in many countries. Access: two CSV files (data dictionary and full data) with a README on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: qualitative coding reflects the researchers' interpretation. Simulation uses: selecting precedents and design options for cooling streets, squares and parks. Related records: the Vienna water features case study and ShadeWalk.
name: Worldwide catalogue of spatio-climatic devices: public spaces with urban cooling techniques (COOLSCAPES)
provider: Ignacio Requena-Ruiz and co-researcher (COOLSCAPES project, ANR)
